# Metrics Section

`saas/metrics` &middot; section-level &middot; category: saas

## Purpose

A metrics summary: two to four numbers each with a label and an optional change note. A preset of the stat grid.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `metrics` | stats |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text | `"Your week in numbers"` |
| `period` | text |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: On the page background color.
- **light**: On the surface color. Sets `background: @colors.surface`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.background"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Each row is a table with exact widths. | Two per row on phones through a media query. Non-Google Gmail accounts show the desktop layout. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('saas/metrics', {
  "heading": "Your week in numbers",
  "period": "2 to 8 June",
  "metrics": [
    {
      "value": "128",
      "label": "Tasks completed",
      "note": "+12% vs last week"
    },
    {
      "value": "14",
      "label": "Projects active",
      "note": "No change"
    },
    {
      "value": "6.5 hrs",
      "label": "Saved by automation",
      "note": "+1.2 hrs"
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "saas/metrics",
  "data": {
    "heading": "Your week in numbers",
    "period": "2 to 8 June",
    "metrics": [
      {
        "value": "128",
        "label": "Tasks completed",
        "note": "+12% vs last week"
      },
      {
        "value": "14",
        "label": "Projects active",
        "note": "No change"
      },
      {
        "value": "6.5 hrs",
        "label": "Saved by automation",
        "note": "+1.2 hrs"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
